description.value: Smitty's is a Canadian family restaurant chain operating since 1960, with this location on Comox Avenue serving the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island. The chain positions itself as 'more than breakfast,' offering a full all-day menu. A familiar and accessible stop for touring cyclists making their way through the Comox area.
